Güneş Sistemi'nin merkezindeki G2V sınıf: The G2V main-sequence star at the centre of the Solar System. It holds 99.86% of the system's mass and converts ~4 million tonnes of matter into energy every second through hydrogen fusion in its core.
Güneş'e en yakın ve en küçük gezegen. Kr: The closest planet to the Sun and the smallest. Its cratered surface resembles the Moon; because of a 3:2 spin–orbit resonance one Mercury day lasts two Mercury years.

Bilinen tek yaşam barındıran gezegen. Yü: The only planet known to harbour life. 71% of its surface is covered by liquid water; its nitrogen–oxygen atmosphere and magnetic field shield the surface from the solar wind.
Dünya'nın tek doğal uydusu ve Güneş Sist: Earth's only natural satellite and the fifth-largest moon in the Solar System. Tidally locked, it always shows the same face to Earth.
Demir oksitle kızıla boyanmış çöl gezege: A desert planet painted red by iron oxide. Home to Olympus Mons, the tallest mountain in the Solar System, and Valles Marineris, its longest canyon.
Mars'ın büyük ve iç uydusu. Mars'a o kad: The larger, inner moon of Mars. It orbits so close that tidal forces will tear it apart or bring it down onto the surface within ~50 million years.
Mars'ın küçük dış uydusu. Regolitle yumu: The small outer moon of Mars. Its cratered surface is softened by regolith; probably a captured asteroid.
Güneş Sistemi'nin en büyük gezegeni; diğ: The largest planet in the Solar System, 2.5 times the mass of all the other planets combined. The Great Red Spot is a giant anticyclone that has raged for at least 350 years.
Güneş Sistemi'nin jeolojik olarak en akt: The most geologically active body in the Solar System, with more than 400 active volcanoes. Jupiter's tidal heating paints its surface in colourful sulphur compounds.
Buz kabuğunun altında Dünya'nın tüm okya: A moon thought to hide more liquid water beneath its ice shell than all of Earth's oceans. Its surface is covered with lines and cracks and has very few craters.
Güneş Sistemi'nin en büyük uydusu; Merkü: The largest moon in the Solar System, bigger than Mercury. The only moon known to have its own magnetic field.
Güneş Sistemi'nin en yoğun kraterlenmiş: The most heavily cratered surface in the Solar System. Geologically dead, an ancient surface ~4 billion years old.
Görkemli halka sistemiyle tanınan gaz de: The gas giant famous for its magnificent ring system. The rings are mostly water ice and, although they span 280,000 km, they are on average only ~10 metres thick.
130 km çapındaki Herschel krateri ile \": An icy moon whose 130 km Herschel crater makes it look like the "Death Star".
Güney kutbundan su buharı ve buz püskürt: Geysers at its south pole spray water vapour and ice; its subsurface ocean is a prime target for astrobiology. The most reflective body in the Solar System.
Neredeyse tamamen su buzundan oluşan uyd: A moon made almost entirely of water ice. The giant valley Ithaca Chasma runs three-quarters of the way around it.
Parlak buz uçurumlarıyla (\"wispy terrai: An icy moon known for its bright ice cliffs ("wispy terrain").
Satürn'ün ikinci büyük uydusu; yoğun kra: Saturn's second-largest moon, with a heavily cratered icy surface.
Yoğun azot atmosferine sahip tek uydu. Y: The only moon with a dense nitrogen atmosphere. Its surface has lakes and seas of liquid methane and ethane, hydrocarbon rain and dunes.
Bir yarısı kömür karası, diğer yarısı ka: The "yin-yang" moon: one half coal-black, the other snow-white. A mysterious ridge 20 km high runs along its equator.
Dönme ekseni 98° yatık olan buz devi; ne: An ice giant tilted 98°, so it practically "rolls" along its orbital plane. Methane in its atmosphere gives it its pale cyan colour.
Güneş Sistemi'nin en yüksek uçurumu Vero: Home to Verona Rupes (20 km), the tallest cliff in the Solar System. Its surface is a patchwork of disconnected geological provinces.
Uranüs'ün en parlak ve jeolojik olarak e: The brightest moon of Uranus, with the geologically youngest surface.
Uranüs'ün en karanlık büyük uydusu. Kutb: The darkest of Uranus's major moons. A bright ring called "Wunda" sits at its pole.
Uranüs'ün en büyük uydusu; dev kanyonlar: The largest moon of Uranus, covered in giant canyons and fault systems.
Uranüs'ün en dış büyük uydusu; kraterli,: The outermost major moon of Uranus; an old cratered surface and a mountain 6 km high.
Güneş'ten en uzak gezegen. Güneş Sistemi: The farthest planet from the Sun. The fastest winds in the Solar System (2,100 km/h) blow here. It was discovered by mathematics, not by telescope (1846).
Neptün etrafında retrograd dönen tek büy: The only large moon orbiting Neptune retrograde — probably a captured Kuiper Belt object. Known for its nitrogen geysers and "cantaloupe" terrain.
The most famous dwarf planet of the Kuiper Belt. Known for the heart-shaped nitrogen-ice plain Sputnik Planitia, a blue layered atmosphere and a binary system with Charon.
Plüton'un yarısı büyüklüğündeki uydusu;: Pluto's moon, half its size; its reddish polar region (Mordor Macula) formed from methane escaping Pluto.
Asteroit Kuşağı'nın en büyük cismi ve iç: The largest body in the Asteroid Belt and the only dwarf planet of the inner Solar System. Known for the bright salt deposits in Occator crater.
Asteroit Kuşağı'nın en parlak ve ikinci: The brightest and second-largest body in the Asteroid Belt; a "protoplanet" with a differentiated interior.
Plüton'dan daha kütleli en büyük bilinen: The most massive known dwarf planet, heavier than Pluto. Its discovery triggered Pluto's reclassification. A very bright surface covered in methane ice.
Yalnızca 3.9 saatte dönen, bu yüzden eli: A dwarf planet spinning once every 3.9 hours, stretched into an ellipsoid as a result. The first trans-Neptunian object known to have its own ring system.
Kuiper Kuşağı'nın en parlak cisimlerinde: One of the brightest Kuiper Belt objects; a reddish surface covered in methane, ethane and tholins.
Her 75–79 yılda bir görünen en ünlü peri: The most famous periodic comet, returning every 75–79 years. On its retrograde orbit it was visited by the Giotto probe in 1986; its next perihelion is in 2061.
İnsan yapımı en uzak nesne. 5 Eylül 1977: The farthest human-made object. Launched on 5 September 1977; after flybys of Jupiter (1979) and Saturn (1980) it crossed the heliopause in 2012 and entered interstellar space. It carries the Golden Record.
Dört dev gezegeni de ziyaret eden tek ar: The only spacecraft to have visited all four giant planets (Jupiter 1979, Saturn 1981, Uranus 1986, Neptune 1989). It crossed the heliopause in 2018 and is in interstellar space in the southern ecliptic hemisphere.
Asteroit kuşağını ve Jüpiter'i geçen ilk: The first spacecraft to cross the asteroid belt and pass Jupiter (1973). The last signal was received on 23 January 2003; it is drifting silently towards Aldebaran.
Satürn'e ulaşan ilk araç (1979). 1995'te: The first spacecraft to reach Saturn (1979). Its mission ended in 1995 as power dwindled; it is drifting towards the constellation Aquila.
Plüton'un (2015) ve Kuiper Kuşağı cismi: The probe that flew past Pluto (2015) and the Kuiper Belt object Arrokoth (2019). It continues to study the heliosphere in the outer Kuiper Belt. (Model is schematic.)
Jüpiter'in kutup yörüngesinde dönen güne: A solar-powered probe in polar orbit around Jupiter. It has mapped the polar storms, interior structure and magnetic field, and in its extended mission makes close flybys of the Galilean moons.
Güneş'e en çok yaklaşan ve en hızlı insa: The closest and fastest human-made object to the Sun: ~6.9 million km at perihelion at 690,000 km/h. Behind its carbon-composite heat shield it studies the solar corona in situ.
James Webb Uzay Teleskobu: 6,5 m katlanı: James Webb Space Telescope: an infrared space telescope with a 6.5 m folding gold-coated mirror. In a halo orbit around the Sun–Earth L2 point, it observes the first galaxies and exoplanet atmospheres.
Hubble Uzay Teleskobu: 2,4 m aynalı görü: Hubble Space Telescope: a visible/UV space telescope with a 2.4 m mirror, in orbit since 1990. Its Deep Field images and measurements of the expansion rate of the universe shaped modern cosmology.
Uluslararası Uzay İstasyonu: alçak Dünya: International Space Station: a modular research station in low Earth orbit, continuously crewed since 2000. 109 m wide, it circles the Earth ~16 times a day.
Gale Krateri'nde Aeolis Mons'un (Mount S: A radioisotope-powered rover climbing the foothills of Aeolis Mons (Mount Sharp) in Gale Crater. It discovered ancient streambeds and organic molecules. (Model is schematic.)
Jezero Krateri'nde eski bir göl deltasın: A rover searching an ancient lake delta in Jezero Crater for signs of life and caching sample tubes. It carried the Ingenuity helicopter.
Alçak Dünya yörüngesinde tankerlerle tam: Fully refuelled by tankers in low Earth orbit, Starship carries ~6.9 km/s of Δv with 100 t of payload: enough to fly directly to Mars and land with aerobraking.
İki Voyager, Titan IIIE-Centaur ile Jüpi: Both Voyagers were launched directly towards Jupiter (C3 ≈ 102 km²/s²) on a Titan IIIE-Centaur; gravity assists at Jupiter and Saturn carried them through the outer Solar System and into interstellar space.
Dünya'dan şimdiye kadar en yüksek hızla: The spacecraft that left Earth at the highest speed ever (16.26 km/s); a Jupiter gravity assist took it to Pluto in 9.5 years.
Doğrudan Jüpiter'e yetecek enerjiyle fır: It could not be launched with enough energy to reach Jupiter directly: an Earth gravity assist two years later added 3.9 km/s and it entered Jupiter orbit in 2016.
Mekiğin yük bölmesinden küçük bir IUS ka: Released from the Shuttle's payload bay with a small IUS stage; it could only reach Jupiter via a Venus–Earth–Earth gravity-assist chain (VEEGA), taking 6 years.
Venüs–Venüs–Dünya–Jüpiter sapanlarıyla S: Reached Saturn in 6.7 years via Venus–Venus–Earth–Jupiter gravity assists; it studied the Saturn system for 13 years and Huygens landed on Titan.
Delta II · 2007 · iyon motoru · Vesta +: Delta II · 2007 · ion engine · Vesta + Ceres
Ksenon iyon motorlarıyla 11 km/s Δv üret: Its xenon ion engines produced 11 km/s of Δv — a budget no chemical rocket could match; the first spacecraft to orbit two separate bodies. (Low thrust: the impulsive calculation here is approximate.)
Güneş'e yaklaşmak için Dünya'nın yörünge: To get close to the Sun it shed Earth's orbital speed with seven Venus gravity assists; the fastest human-made object (192 km/s).
NASA'nın derin uzay mürettebat kapsülü;: NASA's deep-space crew capsule; the SLS upper stage provides ~3.2 km/s for trans-lunar injection (TLI) and Orion's service module ~1.3 km/s. Not enough for Mars on its own.
Kirk'ün gemisi. Orijinal dizinin warp öl: Kirk's ship. On the original series' warp scale, speed = warp³ × c: warp 6 = 216 c, warp 8 = 512 c (emergency).
Galaxy sınıfı yıldız gemisi; impulse mot: A Galaxy-class starship; 0.25c on impulse engines, faster than light by warping space with its warp drive. On the TNG scale warp 9.6 ≈ 1,909 c: 19 hours to Proxima, ~50 years to the far side of the galaxy.
\"Kessel Koşusu'nu 12 parsekten kısa sür: "The ship that made the Kessel Run in less than twelve parsecs." Class 0.5 hyperdrive: across the galaxy in a few days — taken here as ~2×10⁷ c.
Astromek droid destekli sınıf 1 hiperiti: Class 1 hyperdrive assisted by an astromech droid; half the Falcon's speed. Taken here as ~10⁷ c.
The Expanse · MCRN korveti · Epstein sür: The Expanse · MCRN corvette · Epstein drive
Füzyon tahrikli Epstein sürücüsü: yolun: A fusion-powered Epstein drive: it accelerates continuously for half the trip, flips and decelerates for the other half (brachistochrone trajectory). At 1 g, Mars in 2–4 days, Jupiter in ~1 week. Not faster than light; Solar System only.
Ev galaksimiz: ~13 milyar yıllık, 100–40: Our home galaxy: a ~13-billion-year-old barred spiral with 100–400 billion stars. The Sun sits in the Orion Arm, ~8.2 kpc from the centre.
Yerel Grup'un en büyük galaksisi; Samany: The largest galaxy in the Local Group; it will merge with the Milky Way in ~4.5 billion years.
Yerel Grup'un üçüncü büyük üyesi; çıplak: The third-largest member of the Local Group; one of the most distant objects visible to the naked eye.
The brightest satellite galaxy of the Milky Way. It hosts giant star-forming regions such as the Tarantula Nebula.
Samanyolu'nun cüce düzensiz uydu galaksi: A dwarf irregular satellite galaxy of the Milky Way.
Samanyolu tarafından parçalanmakta olan: A dwarf satellite being torn apart by the Milky Way; it lies behind the Galactic centre.
Yoğun yıldız oluşumlu \"starburst\" gala: A "starburst" galaxy with intense star formation.
En yakın aktif galaksi çekirdeği; dev ra: The nearest active galactic nucleus; giant radio lobes and a prominent dust lane.
M81 ile etkileşim sonucu patlayıcı yıldı: A galaxy undergoing explosive star formation triggered by its interaction with M81.
Samanyolu'nun neredeyse iki katı büyüklü: A face-on giant spiral almost twice the size of the Milky Way.
Küçük eşlikçisi NGC 5195 ile etkileşen k: The classic "grand-design" spiral, interacting with its small companion NGC 5195.
Devasa şişkinliği ve keskin toz halkasıy: Known for its huge bulge and sharp dust ring.
Başak Kümesi'nin devi; 6.5 milyar güneş: The giant of the Virgo Cluster; its 6.5-billion-solar-mass black hole was the first ever imaged.
En yakın ve en parlak Seyfert galaksiler: One of the nearest and brightest Seyfert galaxies.
Tam kenardan görülen, Samanyolu'na çok b: An edge-on spiral that closely resembles the Milky Way.
Two spiral galaxies in the process of merging.
Samanyolu'nun merkezindeki süper kütleli: The supermassive black hole at the centre of the Milky Way
Samanyolu'nun dinamik merkezi: 4,3 milyo: The dynamical centre of the Milky Way: a supermassive black hole of 4.3 million solar masses. The orbits of the surrounding S-stars (S2, S38, S55) let us measure its mass directly; in 2022 the Event Horizon Telescope imaged its shadow. The event horizon is 12.7 million km across (~18 solar radii), its shadow 52 micro-arcseconds on the sky.
İlk görüntülenen kara delik: The first black hole ever imaged
İlk görüntülenen kara delik (EHT 2019),: The first black hole ever imaged (EHT 2019), centre of Virgo A
Virgo A (M87) galaksisinin merkezindeki: The 6.5-billion-solar-mass giant at the centre of the galaxy Virgo A (M87); its event horizon spans 38 billion km (~6 times Pluto's orbit). This is the first black hole image, released by the Event Horizon Telescope in 2019: a ring of bright photons around a central shadow. It launches a relativistic jet 5,000 light-years long.
~5 000 ışık yılı, ışık hızının %99'u: ~5,000 light-years, 99% of the speed of light
Keşfedilen ilk kara delik — HDE 226868 i: The first black hole discovered — an X-ray binary with HDE 226868
1964'te roketle keşfedilen X-ışını kayna: An X-ray source discovered by rocket in 1964; in 1971 it became the first black-hole candidate, identified as the invisible 21-solar-mass companion of the blue supergiant HDE 226868. Gas pulled from its companion heats to millions of degrees in the accretion disc and emits X-rays. It was the subject of the famous Hawking–Thorne bet.
HDE 226868 — O9.7 Iab mavi süperdev, ~40: HDE 226868 — O9.7 Iab blue supergiant, ~40 M☉
Bize en yakın bilinen kara delik — sessi: The nearest known black hole — quiet, no disc (lensing only)
Dünya'ya en yakın bilinen kara delik (1: The nearest known black hole to Earth (1,560 light-years). Since it swallows no matter it has no disc and no X-rays; its existence is known only from the orbit of its companion star (Gaia DR3, El-Badry et al. 2023). Here too, only the gravitational lensing of background stars and the shadow of its 28 km event horizon can be seen.
Tekboynuz'da sessiz bir X-ışını novası (: A quiet X-ray nova in Monoceros (V616 Mon)
1975'te Ariel 5 uydusunun yakaladığı pat: An X-ray nova discovered through the outburst caught by the Ariel 5 satellite in 1975; its fading afterwards allowed the companion's orbit to be measured and, in 1986, the mass function confirmed it as a black hole. For a long time it was the nearest known black hole.
2015 patlamasıyla ünlü X-ışını novası: X-ray nova famous for its 2015 outburst
Kuğu takımyıldızındaki düşük kütleli X-ı: A low-mass X-ray binary in Cygnus. During its 1989 and 2015 outbursts it became the brightest X-ray source in the sky within days; in 2015 its jets were seen to change direction within seconds (precession). The first black hole whose distance was measured directly by radio parallax.
Büyük Macellan Bulutu'nda ilk galaksi dı: The first extragalactic black hole, in the Large Magellanic Cloud
1969'da keşfedilen, Büyük Macellan Bulut: A persistently bright X-ray binary in the Large Magellanic Cloud discovered in 1969; one of the first black holes outside the Milky Way to have its mass measured. Its disc, fed by the wind of a giant O star, stays almost always in the "soft" (thermal) state.
LMC'de B yıldızıyla çift, dönüşü yavaş k: A slowly spinning black hole paired with a B star in the LMC
Büyük Macellan Bulutu'nun kuzeyinde, Roc: A black hole in the north of the Large Magellanic Cloud fed by a B star overflowing its Roche lobe. Its disc is remarkably stable compared with its Milky Way counterparts; one of the first objects to have its black-hole spin measured (a* ≈ 0.25).
Üçgen Galaksisi'nde tutulmalı dev X-ışın: An eclipsing massive X-ray binary in the Triangulum Galaxy
Üçgen Galaksisi'nde (M33) 70 güneş kütle: A black hole in the Triangulum Galaxy (M33) orbiting a 70-solar-mass giant star every 3.45 days and regularly eclipsed behind its companion. Because the eclipses pin down the orbital inclination, its mass (15.65 M☉) is known with unusual precision.
Andromeda'nın merkezindeki uykulu dev (1: The sleeping giant at the centre of Andromeda (140 million M☉)
Andromeda Galaksisi'nin çekirdeğindeki 1: The 140-million-solar-mass black hole in the nucleus of the Andromeda Galaxy; 30 times heavier than Sgr A* but likewise almost starved. Around it orbit the eccentric disc of old stars discovered by Hubble (the P1/P2 double nucleus) and the P3 cluster of young blue stars.
En yakın aktif galaksi çekirdeği; dev ra: The nearest active galactic nucleus; giant radio jets
Centaurus A'nın tozlu merkezinde saklı 5: A 55-million-solar-mass active black hole hidden in the dusty centre of Centaurus A. The jets it fires in both directions form radio lobes 20 times the width of the Moon on the sky; in 2021 the EHT imaged the base of the jet on black-hole scales.
Sombrero Galaksisi'nin merkezi · 1 milya: Centre of the Sombrero Galaxy · 1 billion M☉
Sombrero Galaksisi'nin (M104) dev şişkin: A black hole in the middle of the huge bulge of the Sombrero Galaxy (M104), 230 times heavier than the one at the centre of the Milky Way. It feeds gently as a low-luminosity active nucleus (LINER).
Su maserleriyle en hassas ölçülen kara d: The black-hole mass measured most precisely, using water masers
M106 (NGC 4258) merkezindeki kara deliği: Clouds of water masers orbit the black hole at the centre of M106 (NGC 4258) in perfect agreement with Kepler's laws. This disc yields both the black hole's mass (40 million M☉) and the galaxy's distance geometrically; it is an anchor of the cosmic distance ladder.
Bode Galaksisi'nin düşük parlaklıklı çek: The low-luminosity nucleus of Bode's Galaxy
M81'in merkezindeki 70 milyon güneş kütl: The 70-million-solar-mass black hole at the centre of M81; one of the nearest and best-studied low-luminosity active nuclei, a bridge between Sgr A* and bright quasars.
Görüntü: Schwarzschild metriğinde ışık y: Rendering: real-time screen-space tracing of light paths (null geodesics) in the Schwarzschild metric; Doppler beaming and gravitational redshift are applied to the disc.
Orion'un kılıcındaki çıplak gözle görüle: The naked-eye nebula in Orion's sword; a star factory 1,300 light-years away and 24 light-years across. The four hot stars of the Trapezium cluster at its centre ionise and light up the cloud; Hubble has imaged hundreds of protoplanetary discs (proplyds) within it.
Yedi Kız Kardeş — en ünlü açık küme: The Seven Sisters — the most famous open cluster
Boğa takımyıldızındaki 100 milyon yaşınd: A 100-million-year-old open cluster in Taurus; it holds ~1,000 stars, and its bright B-type members light up the dust cloud they are passing through as a blue reflection nebula. Every culture in human history has a name for it.
Güney gökyüzünün dev bulutsusu; Eta Cari: The giant nebula of the southern sky; home of Eta Carinae
Orion Bulutsusu'ndan dört kat daha büyük: Four times larger and far brighter than the Orion Nebula; it hosts dozens of the Milky Way's most massive stars (Eta Carinae, WR 25, the Trumpler 14/16 clusters). The "Cosmic Cliffs" in JWST's first images lie at the edge of this nebula.
Bilinen en kütleli ve en parlak yıldız: Most massive and brightest star known
Samanyolu'nun en parlak ve en kararsız y: The brightest and most unstable star in the Milky Way
Yaklaşık 100 ve 30 güneş kütleli iki dev: A binary of two giant stars of roughly 100 and 30 solar masses. In the "Great Eruption" of 1843 it became the second-brightest star in the sky and ejected more than 10 solar masses of material, forming the Homunculus Nebula. It is expected to go supernova in the near (astronomical) future.
1054 süpernovasının kalıntısı ve pulsarı: The remnant and pulsar of the supernova of 1054
1054 yılında Çinli gökbilimcilerin gündü: The remnant of the supernova that Chinese astronomers saw even in daylight in 1054. At its centre the Crab Pulsar, spinning 30 times a second, powers the nebula with synchrotron radiation; it is still expanding at 1,500 km/s. The first object in the Messier catalogue.
\"Yaratılış Sütunları\"nın bulunduğu bul: The nebula of the "Pillars of Creation"
Hubble'ın 1995'teki ikonik \"Yaratılış S: Hubble's iconic 1995 "Pillars of Creation" photograph shows the 4–5-light-year-long columns of cold gas at the heart of this nebula, where new stars are being born. The young cluster NGC 6611 lights the nebula.
Yay takımyıldızında çıplak gözle görülen: A giant H II region visible to the naked eye in Sagittarius
Galaktik merkez yönünde, Yay takımyıldız: Towards the Galactic centre in Sagittarius; a bright emission nebula 110 × 50 light-years in size. Its "Hourglass" structure and Bok globules show the early stages of star formation.
Samanyolu'nun en büyük küresel kümesi: The largest globular cluster of the Milky Way
10 milyon yıldızlı, 4 milyon güneş kütle: A giant globular cluster of 10 million stars and 4 million solar masses — probably the core of a dwarf galaxy swallowed by the Milky Way. There is strong evidence for an intermediate-mass black hole (~40,000 M☉) at its centre.
Gökyüzündeki ikinci en parlak küresel kü: The second-brightest globular cluster in the sky
Küçük Macellan Bulutu'nun hemen yanında: Although it appears right next to the Small Magellanic Cloud, it is 15 times closer — a globular cluster belonging to the Milky Way's halo. Its dense core hosts dozens of millisecond pulsars.
Samanyolu'nun en kütleli genç süper yıld: The most massive young super star cluster in the Milky Way
Yalnızca 3–5 milyon yaşında, ~60 000 gün: A "super star cluster" only 3–5 million years old with ~60,000 solar masses: hundreds of giant stars, 24 Wolf-Rayet stars, yellow hypergiants and a magnetar (CXOU J1647). Heavily dimmed by dust in the optical, it shines in the infrared.
Çalgı takımyıldızında, ömrünün sonundaki: In Lyra, the outer layers shed by a Sun-like star at the end of its life. The 120,000 K white dwarf at the centre ionises the ring; a preview of the Sun's fate ~5 billion years from now.
Messier'nin 1764'te keşfettiği, türünün: Discovered by Messier in 1764, the first of its kind. At 380 pc it is one of the nearest and brightest planetary nebulae; it has been expanding for ~10,000 years.
\"Tanrı'nın Gözü\" — en yakın gezegenims: The "Eye of God" — one of the nearest planetary nebulae
Kova takımyıldızında, yalnızca 650 ışık: In Aquarius, only 650 light-years away; it covers half the apparent size of the Moon on the sky. Thousands of comet-like knots along its inner edge are sculpted by the wind of the central star.
Gökyüzünün en parlak radyo kaynağı; ~168: The brightest radio source in the sky; remnant of a supernova around 1680
Yaklaşık 340 yıl önce patlayan bir süper: The remnant of a supernova that exploded about 340 years ago — one of the last observed in the Milky Way, though dust may have hidden the explosion. The neutron star at its centre was discovered in Chandra's first-light image; JWST revealed the remnant's "Green Monster" structure.
Yerel Grup'un en büyük yıldız oluşum böl: The largest star-forming region in the Local Group
Büyük Macellan Bulutu'nun 1 000 ışık yıl: The Large Magellanic Cloud's giant H II region, 1,000 light-years across; if it were where the Orion Nebula is, it would be bright enough to cast shadows. The R136 cluster at its centre holds the most massive stars known; SN 1987A exploded nearby.
Tarantula Bulutsusu'nun kalbindeki R136: The brightest member of the R136 cluster at the heart of the Tarantula Nebula: about 200 solar masses, 4.7 million solar luminosities, a surface temperature of 46,000 K. A hydrogen-burning Wolf-Rayet star (WN5h); younger than 1 million years and losing thousands of Earth masses a year to its winds.
Teleskop çağının en yakın süpernovası (1: The nearest supernova of the telescope era (1987)
23 Şubat 1987'de patlayan mavi süperdev: The remnant of the blue supergiant Sanduleak −69° 202, which exploded on 23 February 1987; the first object from which supernova neutrinos were detected. Hubble and JWST have shown the blast wave hitting rings ejected 20,000 years earlier and, in 2024, traces of the neutron star at the centre.
LMC'nin genç çift kümesi — Samanyolu'nda: The LMC's young double cluster — nothing like it in the Milky Way
Yalnızca 100 milyon yaşında ama küresel: A star cluster only 100 million years old yet as massive as a globular cluster; beside it is an even younger companion cluster, just 4 million years old. Such young, massive clusters no longer form in the Milky Way.
Bilinen en büyük yıldızlardan — 1 500 gü: One of the largest stars known — 1,500 solar radii
Büyük Macellan Bulutu'nda, Güneş'in yeri: A red hypergiant in the Large Magellanic Cloud that, put in the Sun's place, would swallow Jupiter's orbit. In 2024 it became the first star outside the Milky Way to be imaged up close with the VLTI: wrapped in a thick cocoon of dust and in its final stages before a supernova.
Küçük Macellan Bulutu'nun en parlak yıld: The brightest star-forming region of the Small Magellanic Cloud
Metal fakiri Küçük Macellan Bulutu'ndaki: The most active star factory in the metal-poor Small Magellanic Cloud; JWST showed that it holds enough dust to form planets under conditions resembling the early universe.
SMC'nin kenarında yıldız oluşturan genç: A young star-forming cluster at the edge of the SMC (a Hubble classic)
Küçük Macellan Bulutu'nun dış kanadında,: A 5-million-year-old cluster on the outer wing of the Small Magellanic Cloud, carving out the surrounding N90 nebula as it grows. Famous for the Hubble photograph with distant galaxies visible in the background.
Andromeda'nın güneybatı sarmal kolunda 4: An OB star cloud 4,000 light-years across in Andromeda's south-western spiral arm; the richest young stellar association in the Local Group. Even a small telescope shows it as a bright patch in the disc of M31.
Yerel Grup'un en kütleli küresel kümesi: The most massive globular cluster in the Local Group
Andromeda'nın halesinde, merkezden 130 0: In Andromeda's halo, 130,000 light-years from the centre; a globular cluster of 10 million solar masses, twice the mass of Omega Centauri. Like Omega Centauri it is probably the core of a swallowed dwarf galaxy; it may harbour a ~20,000 M☉ black hole.
Evrenin boyutunu değiştiren yıldız (1923: The star that changed the size of the universe (1923)
Edwin Hubble'ın 1923'te Andromeda'da bul: The variable star Edwin Hubble found in Andromeda in 1923; its period–luminosity relation proved that the "Andromeda Nebula" is a separate galaxy outside the Milky Way. A Cepheid with a 31.4-day period; today the Hubble Space Telescope has observed it too.
Samanyolu dışında gözlenen ilk süpernova: The first supernova observed outside the Milky Way
1885'te Andromeda'nın merkezine 16 yay s: A supernova that flared in 1885 just 16 arcseconds from Andromeda's centre, almost visible to the naked eye (magnitude 5.8). In 1988 Hubble found its remnant as a dark cloud of iron silhouetted against Andromeda's bulge.
Yerel Grup'un en büyük H II bölgelerinde: One of the largest H II regions in the Local Group
Üçgen Galaksisi'nde 1 500 ışık yılı geni: A stellar nursery in the Triangulum Galaxy 1,500 light-years across, 100 times larger than the Orion Nebula; a giant bubble of gas carved out by more than 200 hot giant stars. Together with the Tarantula it is one of the largest nebulae in the Local Group.
Gökyüzünün en parlak yıldızı: The brightest star in the sky
1054 süpernovasının kalbindeki saniyede: The neutron star spinning 30 times a second at the heart of the 1054 supernova
Yengeç Bulutsusu'nu besleyen genç pulsar: The young pulsar powering the Crab Nebula: the core that collapsed in the supernova of 1054 now spins 30 times a second and pumps its rotational energy (100,000 times the Sun's total output) into the nebula through winds and beams. One of the first pulsars seen pulsing in radio, optical, X-rays and gamma rays; the first pulsar discovered through its optical pulses (1969).
Gökyüzünün en parlak gama-ışını kaynağı;: The brightest gamma-ray source in the sky; the "glitching" pulsar
Vela Süpernova Kalıntısı'nın merkezindek: The 11,000-year-old pulsar at the centre of the Vela Supernova Remnant. It is the brightest persistent gamma-ray source in the sky and regularly "glitches": its spin suddenly speeds up — the most direct evidence for the superfluid interior of neutron stars. Its discovery (1968) proved that pulsars are born in supernovae.
Keşfedilen ilk pulsar — Jocelyn Bell Bur: The first pulsar discovered — Jocelyn Bell Burnell, 1967
28 Kasım 1967'de Cambridge'de doktora öğ: The regular 1.337-second pulses that PhD student Jocelyn Bell Burnell noticed on her chart recordings in Cambridge on 28 November 1967. Half-jokingly named "LGM-1" (Little Green Men); the rotating-neutron-star explanation came in 1968 and Hewish received the 1974 Nobel Prize. Its pulse profiles were immortalised on the cover of Joy Division's "Unknown Pleasures".
Kütleçekim dalgalarının ilk kanıtı — 199: The first evidence for gravitational waves — 1993 Nobel Prize
1974'te Hulse ve Taylor'ın Arecibo ile b: The first double neutron star, found by Hulse and Taylor with Arecibo in 1974: a 59 ms pulsar orbits an unseen neutron star every 7.75 hours on an orbit slightly larger than the Sun's diameter. The orbit shrinks by 3.5 m a year, exactly as general relativity's prediction of gravitational waves requires; they will merge in ~300 million years.
Hulse–Taylor çiftinin görünmeyen ikinci: The unseen second neutron star of the Hulse–Taylor binary; its pulses do not reach us (its beams miss Earth, or it is radio-quiet). Its existence is known from the Doppler shifts in the pulsar's pulse timing.
En yakın ve en parlak milisaniye pulsarı: The nearest and brightest millisecond pulsar; it has a white-dwarf companion
1993'te Parkes ile keşfedilen, bize en y: The nearest millisecond pulsar, discovered with Parkes in 1993. Its 5.76 ms period is as stable as an atomic clock; its orbit and distance are known to microsecond precision from pulsar timing. It is a cornerstone of pulsar timing arrays (nanohertz gravitational-wave detectors). It has a 0.25-solar-mass helium white dwarf companion orbiting every 5.74 days.
İlk keşfedilen ötegezegenlerin yıldızı (: The star of the first exoplanets ever discovered (1992)
Aleksander Wolszczan'ın 1990'da Arecibo: The millisecond pulsar Aleksander Wolszczan found with Arecibo in 1990; microsecond irregularities in its pulses revealed the first planets outside the Solar System in 1992. Its three planets (Draugr, Poltergeist, Phobetor) probably formed in a disc left over from the supernova; dead worlds constantly bathed in the pulsar's radiation.
Bilinen en hızlı dönen pulsar: saniyede: The fastest-spinning pulsar known: 716 turns a second
Terzan 5 küresel kümesinde 2004'te keşfe: A millisecond pulsar discovered in the globular cluster Terzan 5 in 2004. It spins 716 times a second; its equator moves at nearly a quarter of the speed of light — very close to the limit neutron-star matter can withstand. It is in a 26-hour eclipsing orbit with a bloated companion star.
Radyo-sessiz gama pulsarı; adı Milano le: A radio-quiet gamma-ray pulsar; its name means "it's not there" in Milanese dialect
1972'de SAS-2 uydusunun bulduğu gizemli: The mysterious gamma-ray source found by the SAS-2 satellite in 1972; for 20 years no radio or optical counterpart could be found ("Geminga": the gamma-ray source in Gemini — and in Milanese dialect "gh'è minga", "it's not there"). In 1992 ROSAT detected 237 ms X-ray pulses. One of the nearest pulsars to us.
Evrenin en güçlü mıknatısı; 2004 dev pat: The most powerful magnet in the universe; its 2004 giant flare rattled Earth's ionosphere
Manyetik alanı 10¹⁵ gauss'u aşan bir mag: A magnetar with a magnetic field exceeding 10¹⁵ gauss — a quadrillion times Earth's. On 27 December 2004 a crust fracture on its surface released, in 0.2 seconds, as much energy as the Sun emits in 250,000 years; from 50,000 light-years away it ionised Earth's upper atmosphere and saturated satellite detectors. Slowly rotating (7.56 s) but with immense fields, such stars are soft gamma repeaters (SGRs).
Görüntü: dönme ekseninden eğik manyetik: Rendering: two beam cones along a magnetic axis tilted from the spin axis; the brightness pulses each time a cone sweeps across the line of sight (lighthouse effect). Beam geometry is schematic.
Güneş'ten Plüton'a: sekiz gezegen, bir a: From the Sun to Pluto: eight planets, one moon, and one dwarf planet.
Güneş Sistemi turuna hoş geldiniz. Yolcu: Welcome to the Solar System tour. Our journey begins at the center of everything, the Sun. This star, 4.5 billion years old, carries 99.8 percent of the total mass of the system all by itself. Its diameter is 1,400,000 kilometers; 109 Earths fit inside it side by side. Its surface is 5,500 degrees, while its core is 15 million degrees. The light you are seeing right now leaves here and reaches Earth in 8 minutes and 20 seconds.
İlk durağımız Merkür, en küçük ve Güneş': Our first stop is Mercury, the smallest planet and the closest to the Sun. One trip around the Sun takes only 88 days. Its atmosphere is so thin it might as well not exist; that is why the day side rises to 430 degrees while the night side drops to minus 180 degrees. Its surface is covered with craters, just like the Moon. Right now, Europe and Japan's joint spacecraft BepiColombo is on its way toward it.
Venüs, boyutuyla Dünya'nın ikizi sayılır: Venus is considered Earth's twin in size, but its conditions are a true hell. Its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere raises the surface pressure to 92 times that of Earth and, through the greenhouse effect, drives the temperature up to 465 degrees. It is hotter even than Mercury, which is closer to the Sun. Its clouds are sulfuric acid. Venus rotates in the opposite direction and very slowly: a day there is longer than a year.
Ve işte evimiz: Dünya. Evrende yaşam bar: And here is our home: Earth. The only place in the universe we know of that harbors life. 71 percent of its surface is covered with liquid water; that is why it looks blue from space. Its strong magnetic field protects us from the solar wind, and the ozone layer filters ultraviolet rays. The Moon's gravity, in turn, keeps Earth's axial tilt steady, so that the seasons stay regular.
Ay, Dünya'nın tek doğal uydusu ve insanl: The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite and the only other celestial body humans have set foot on. Between 1969 and 1972, twelve astronauts walked on its surface on the Apollo missions. It is 384,000 kilometers away and always shows us the same face, because its rotation is locked to its orbit. Every year it moves about 4 centimeters farther from us.
Kızıl Gezegen Mars. Rengini yüzeyindeki: The Red Planet, Mars. It takes its color from the rusted iron on its surface. Its diameter is about half of Earth's, but it is home to the largest volcano in the Solar System: Olympus Mons, 22 kilometers high. The Valles Marineris canyon, 4,000 kilometers long, is long enough to stretch from one end of the American continent to the other. Billions of years ago there were rivers and lakes on its surface; today, robots are searching for traces of that water.
Jüpiter, gezegenlerin kralı. Kütlesi diğ: Jupiter, king of the planets. Its mass is two and a half times the total of all the other planets; 1,300 Earths fit inside it. It has no surface; the colorful bands you see are giant cloud belts in an atmosphere of hydrogen and helium. The Great Red Spot is a storm that has lasted at least 350 years and is larger than Earth. This giant's day lasts only 10 hours, and more than 95 known moons orbit around it.
Satürn, hiç şüphesiz Güneş Sistemi'nin e: Saturn is, without a doubt, the most elegant planet in the Solar System. Its rings are made mostly of water ice; their width reaches 280,000 kilometers, while their thickness is only about 10 meters in most places. The planet itself is so light that if you put it in a big enough ocean, it would float. At its north pole, a mysterious hexagonal storm rotates, each side as large as Earth.
Uranüs, yan yatmış gezegen. Ekseni doksa: Uranus, the planet lying on its side. Its axis is tilted 98 degrees; that is, it all but rolls as it orbits the Sun. Because of this, its poles experience 42 years of day and 42 years of night. It looks blue-green because methane gas absorbs red light. It is the first planet discovered with a telescope, by William Herschel in 1781, and only Voyager 2 saw it up close.
Neptün, Güneş'ten en uzak gezegen. Teles: Neptune, the farthest planet from the Sun. It was discovered not with a telescope, but on paper: mathematicians studying the deviations in Uranus's orbit calculated its position, and in 1846 it was found right there. Its winds exceed 2,100 kilometers per hour; they are the fastest winds in the Solar System. One trip around the Sun takes 165 years. Its large moon Triton orbits in the opposite direction; it is probably a captured Kuiper Belt object.
Son durağımız Plüton. Bin dokuz yüz otuz: Our last stop is Pluto. It was discovered in 1930 and was considered the ninth planet until 2006; it is now a dwarf planet. Until New Horizons flew past it in 2015, it was nothing but a blurry dot. The spacecraft found a giant heart shape, nitrogen glaciers, and mountains of water ice on its surface. The surface temperature is minus 230 degrees. Its moon Charon is so large that the two of them orbit together around a common center of mass. Our Solar System tour ends here; have a good journey.
Kızıl Gezegen, iki küçük ayı ve yüzeyind: The Red Planet, its two small moons, and the exploration vehicles roaming its surface.
Mars turuna hoş geldiniz. Kızıl Gezegen,: Welcome to the Mars tour. The Red Planet is the fourth planet from the Sun, and the world humanity has sent the most vehicles to. Its day is very similar to Earth's: 24 hours and 37 minutes. Its year, though, is 687 days. Its atmosphere is very thin and consists almost entirely of carbon dioxide; the average temperature is minus 60 degrees. Even so, there is ice at its poles, and dried-up riverbeds and ancient lake beds on its surface.
The larger of Mars's two small moons is Phobos. It is a potato-shaped rock only 22 kilometers wide. It orbits at a distance of 6,000 kilometers from the planet; this is the closest orbit of any moon in the Solar System. It is so fast that it circles Mars in 7 hours and 39 minutes, and seen from the surface of Mars it rises in the west. It is dropping by 2 meters every century; within about 50 million years it will either crash into Mars or break apart and turn into a ring.
Deimos, Mars'ın daha küçük ve daha uzak: Deimos is Mars's smaller and more distant moon. Its diameter is about 12 kilometers, and it circles the planet in 30 hours. Its surface is smoother than Phobos's, because its craters are filled with a thick layer of dust. Seen from the surface of Mars, it is no different from a bright star. It is still debated whether both moons are captured asteroids or the remnants of a giant collision; Japan's MMX mission will bring a sample from Phobos to answer this question.
Şimdi yüzeye iniyoruz: karşınızda Curios: Now we descend to the surface: before you is Curiosity. This car-sized robot, weighing 1 ton, landed in Gale Crater in August 2012, lowered on cables by a sky crane. It generates its energy from the heat of plutonium, so it is unaffected by dust storms. It proved that a lake lasting millions of years once existed on the crater floor, and it found the chemical ingredients needed for life. For more than 10 years it has been climbing the slopes of Mount Sharp, reading Mars's climate history layer by layer.
Ve Perseverance, Mars'taki en gelişmiş r: And Perseverance, the most advanced robot on Mars. It landed in Jezero Crater in February 2021; this is an ancient delta where a river emptied into a lake 3.5 billion years ago. Its mission is to search for traces of past microbial life and to fill titanium tubes with rock samples, leaving them for a future mission to bring to Earth. The small helicopter it brought with it, Ingenuity, became the first vehicle to fly on another planet, and it carried out 72 flights instead of the planned 5. The MOXIE experiment, for its part, opened the way for future astronauts by producing oxygen from the air of Mars.
Mars'tan ayrılmadan önce bir kez daha ge: Before we leave Mars, let's look back once more. Today nearly a dozen active vehicles are operating in its orbit and on its surface. The findings are consistent: Mars was once a warm, moist, and perhaps habitable world. When it lost its magnetic field, the solar wind swept its atmosphere into space, and the planet turned into a cold desert. Even so, the first planet humanity will one day set foot on will most likely be this one. Our Mars tour has come to an end.
Dev gezegen, dört Galileo ayı ve kutupla: The giant planet, the four Galilean moons, and Juno orbiting over its poles.
Jüpiter sistemine hoş geldiniz. Bu dev,: Welcome to the Jupiter system. This giant is almost like a small solar system: more than 95 moons orbit around it. The planet is so large that 1,300 Earths can fit inside it, and its powerful magnetic field is the largest structure in the Solar System; if it could be seen in the sky, it would appear larger than the full Moon. In 1610, Galileo discovered its four large moons with his small telescope, and this became the first evidence that not everything revolves around Earth. Now we will visit those four moons in turn.
Io, Güneş Sistemi'nin en volkanik dünyas: Io, the most volcanic world in the Solar System. It is constantly squeezed and stretched between the gravity of Jupiter and the other moons; this tidal heating melts its interior. There are more than 400 active volcanoes on its surface, and some of them hurl lava hundreds of kilometers high. The yellow, orange, and red colors come from sulfur and sulfur compounds. Its surface is renewed so quickly that it has almost no impact craters.
Europa, yaşam arayışının en umut verici: Europa, the most promising destination in the search for life. Beneath its smooth ice shell, a global saltwater ocean holding twice as much water as all the oceans on Earth is thought to exist. The brown lines on the surface are places where the ice cracks and water from below seeps upward. NASA's Europa Clipper spacecraft was launched in 2024 and, in 2030, with about 50 close flybys, will investigate whether this ocean is habitable.
Ganymede, Güneş Sistemi'nin en büyük ayı: Ganymede, the largest moon in the Solar System. It is even larger than the planet Mercury. It is the only known moon with its own magnetic field; this field forms a small bubble inside Jupiter's and creates auroras at its poles. Its surface is of two different ages: dark, cratered old regions and light-colored, grooved younger regions. Beneath its ice shell, it has an ocean too. The European Space Agency's JUICE spacecraft will enter orbit around it in 2031.
Callisto, dört Galileo ayının en dıştaki: Callisto, the outermost and the quietest of the four Galilean moons. Its surface is the most densely cratered surface in the Solar System; it has barely changed for 4 billion years. Because it is far from Jupiter, it is not affected by tidal heating and remains outside the radiation belts. This makes it the safest candidate for a crewed base in the future. There are also clues that an ocean may exist beneath it.
Son olarak Juno'ya bakalım. Bu NASA arac: Finally, let's look at Juno. This NASA spacecraft entered orbit around Jupiter in July 2016. It is the first spacecraft to operate on solar power this far from the Sun; its three giant panels take up as much space as a basketball court. To protect itself from radiation, it travels in a long, elliptical orbit that passes over the poles, and on each pass it flies a few thousand kilometers above the clouds. It discovered giant cyclones at Jupiter's poles and showed that Jupiter's core is larger and more diffuse than had been thought. Our tour of Jupiter ends here.
Halkalar, kalın atmosferli Titan, gayzer: Rings, Titan with its thick atmosphere, Enceladus with its geysers, and two strange moons.
Satürn turuna hoş geldiniz. Güneş'ten al: Welcome to the Saturn tour. The sixth planet from the Sun is a gas giant nine times the size of Earth in diameter. Its density is lower than water; this is unique for a planet. At its equator, winds reach 1,800 kilometers per hour. The Cassini spacecraft studied this system for 13 years, from 2004 to 2017, and completed its mission by diving into the planet's atmosphere.
Şimdi halkalara daha yakından bakalım. B: Now let's take a closer look at the rings. This giant disk is not actually a single structure; it is made up of billions of pieces of ice, from microscopic dust to the size of a house. Its width exceeds 280,000 kilometers, but its thickness is less than 10 meters in most places: even thinner than a sheet of paper to scale. The largest gap between them, the Cassini Division, is opened by the gravity of the small moon Mimas. The rings are probably only a few hundred million years old, and they are slowly raining down onto the planet.
Titan, Satürn'ün en büyük ayı ve Güneş S: Titan is Saturn's largest moon and the only moon in the Solar System with a thick atmosphere. Its nitrogen-dominated atmosphere is 50 percent denser than Earth's and hides the surface with an orange haze. On its surface there are lakes, rivers, and rains of liquid methane and ethane; at minus 180 degrees, water is as hard as rock. In 2005, the Huygens probe landed on its surface. NASA's nuclear-powered drone called Dragonfly will arrive here in 2034 and fly over the sand dunes.
Enceladus yalnızca beş yüz kilometre çap: Enceladus is only 500 kilometers in diameter, but it is one of the most fascinating worlds in the Solar System. From four cracks at the south pole called tiger stripes, hundreds of geysers spray water vapor and ice crystals into space. Cassini flew through these fountains and found salt, organic molecules, and hydrogen; exactly the materials needed for life. These ice grains feed Saturn's E ring. Its surface is pure white like fresh snow, and it reflects nearly all of the sunlight.
Mimas'ı gördüğünüz anda tanırsınız: dev: You recognize Mimas the moment you see it: the giant Herschel Crater gives it the appearance of the Death Star from Star Wars. The crater is 130 kilometers wide; that is, one third of the moon's diameter. If this collision had been a little more violent, Mimas would have been shattered to pieces. When the small wobbles in its orbit were studied in 2024, a surprising result emerged: beneath the ice shell of this small moon that looks frozen, there may be a young ocean.
Son durağımız Iapetus, Güneş Sistemi'nin: Our last stop is Iapetus, one of the strangest moons in the Solar System. One half is as white as snow, the other half as black as coal. Because the same face always points forward in its orbit, it sweeps up the dark dust from the outer rings, and ice evaporates from the warming dark regions and falls onto the bright side. Right in the middle of its equator stretches a mountain ridge 13 kilometers high and 1,300 kilometers long; this gives it the appearance of a walnut. Our Saturn tour has come to an end.
En yakın uyuyan kara delikten galaksiler: From the nearest sleeping black hole to the giants at the centers of galaxies.
Kara delikler turuna hoş geldiniz. Başla: Welcome to the black holes tour. Our starting point is a classic: Cygnus X-1. This X-ray source, discovered with a rocket in 1964, became the first object identified as a black hole in 1971. It is 21 solar masses, and once every five and a half days it orbits their common center of mass together with its blue supergiant companion HDE 226868. Gas drawn from its companion heats to millions of degrees in a bright disk. Stephen Hawking had bet that this object was not a black hole; in 1990 he conceded his defeat.
Gaia BH Bir, bize en yakın bilinen kara: Gaia BH1, the closest known black hole to us: 1,560 light-years. It has neither a disk nor does it emit X-rays; it is completely silent. Its existence was understood only from a Sun-like star wobbling around an invisible companion once every 186 days. This wobble was revealed in 2022 by the precise position measurements of the Gaia satellite. It is 9.6 solar masses, and the diameter of its event horizon is only 56 kilometers. Here you can see it only by the gravitational lensing that bends the stars in the background.
V Dört Yüz Dört Cygni, bir X-ışını novas: V404 Cygni, an X-ray nova. It is silent most of the time, but when gas accumulated from its companion crosses a threshold, it erupts within a few days and becomes the brightest X-ray source in the sky. These outbursts were observed in 1938, 1956, 1989, and 2015. During the 2015 outburst, its jets were seen to change direction within seconds; the black hole's spin was dragging spacetime and wobbling the disk like a spinning top. It is 9 solar masses, and it is the first black hole whose distance was measured directly by radio parallax.
Şimdi galaksimizin kalbine, yirmi altı b: Now we're going to the heart of our galaxy, 26,000 light-years away. Sagittarius A star, the supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way: 4.3 million solar masses. The stars around it allowed us to measure its mass; the star named S2 approaches it so closely once every 16 years that it reaches 3 percent of the speed of light. These observations brought the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2020. In 2022 the Event Horizon Telescope imaged its shadow. Right now it is quite quiet; it is swallowing almost no matter.
Son durağımız, fotoğrafı çekilen ilk kar: Our last stop, the first black hole to be photographed: M87 star. It sits at the center of the giant elliptical galaxy Virgo A, 55 million light-years away. It is six and a half billion solar masses; its event horizon is six times wider than Pluto's orbit. The famous orange ring image published in 2019 is the light of the hot gas surrounding its shadow. From here a jet shoots out at nearly the speed of light and extends for 5,000 light-years. Our black holes tour has come to an end.
Saniyede yüzlerce kez dönen nötron yıldı: Neutron stars that spin hundreds of times a second, and the physics they changed.
Pulsarlar turuna hoş geldiniz. Her şey b: Welcome to the pulsars tour. It all began in 1967, when Jocelyn Bell, a PhD student at Cambridge, noticed a strange signal in the radio data that repeated every 1.3 seconds. The signal was so regular that her team half-jokingly named it LGM 1, meaning Little Green Men. PSR B 1919 plus 21, before you, is that very first pulsar. It was in fact a neutron star, spinning like a lighthouse and directing its beam toward us on every turn.
Yengeç Pulsarı, bin elli dört yılındaki: The Crab Pulsar is the neutron star left behind by the supernova of 1054. It spins 30 times a second and lights up the entire Crab Nebula with its energy. It is only 20 kilometers across, yet heavier than the Sun; a sugar-cube-sized piece of its matter weighs as much as a mountain. It pulses at every wavelength, from radio waves to gamma rays. It is the first pulsar definitively matched to an observable supernova, and it proved that pulsars are born from exploding stars.
Vela Pulsarı, bin ışık yılı uzaklıktaki: The Vela Pulsar is one of the brightest radio pulsars, 1,000 light-years away. It is the remnant of a star that exploded 11,000 years ago, and it spins 11 times a second. From time to time it suddenly speeds up; these events are called glitches. They are the result of quakes in the star's solid crust, or of the superfluid neutrons in its interior transferring energy to the crust. So by studying this little star, we learn how matter behaves at densities that cannot be produced in any laboratory on Earth.
PSR J Bin Yedi Yüz Kırk Sekiz eksi Yirmi: PSR J 1748 minus 2446 A D is the fastest-spinning pulsar known: 716 revolutions a second. The speed at its equator approaches a quarter of the speed of light; if it spun even a little faster, it would fly apart. It reached this speed by accelerating for millions of years on matter drawn from its companion star. It lives in a dense globular cluster called Terzan 5, in the constellation Sagittarius. Its companion is swollen by the pulsar's intense radiation, and for about 40 percent of the orbit it covers the pulsar and cuts off its signal.
Hulse ve Taylor Çifti, fiziğin en önemli: The Hulse–Taylor binary was the setting for one of the most important experiments in physics. In this system, discovered in 1974, a pulsar and another neutron star orbit their common center of mass once every 7 hours and 45 minutes. Their orbits shrink by a few millimeters every year. This matches exactly the energy loss through gravitational waves that Einstein predicted: the first indirect evidence for general relativity. With this discovery, Russell Hulse and Joseph Taylor won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1993. The two stars will merge within 300 million years.
İlk ötegezegenler bir Güneş benzeri yıld: The first exoplanets were found not around a Sun-like star, but around a dead star. In 1992, Aleksander Wolszczan and Dale Frail deduced the planets orbiting this pulsar, named Lich, from millisecond delays in its pulse. These three planets, named Draugr, Poltergeist, and Phobetor, probably re-formed from debris left over from the supernova. Draugr is the least massive exoplanet known; it weighs only twice as much as the Moon. Under the pulsar's lethal radiation, life cannot even be imagined; that is why their names are taken from ghosts and the living dead.
Son durağımız bir magnetar: SGR Bin Seki: Our final stop is a magnetar: SGR 1806 minus 20. Magnetars are neutron stars with the strongest magnetic fields in the universe; this field is a thousand trillion times stronger than Earth's, and from 1,000 kilometers away it erases a credit card. On December 27, 2004, its crust cracked and, in a tenth of a second, it flung out as much energy as the Sun emits in 100,000 years. This explosion, coming from 50,000 light-years away, measurably ionized Earth's upper atmosphere and blinded the detectors of satellites. It is the brightest event observed from outside the Solar System to date. Our pulsars tour has come to an end.
Gaz bulutundan kara deliğe: yıldızların: From a gas cloud to a black hole: the birth, life, and death of stars.
Bu turda bir yıldızın yaşam öyküsünü, do: On this tour we will follow the life story of a star, from its birth to its death. The story begins in places like this: the Orion Nebula, a giant star factory 1,350 light-years away from us. Cold gas and dust collapse under their own weight, forming hundreds of new stars. The four bright Trapezium stars at the center illuminate the nebula from within with their ultraviolet light. In the sky it is seen with the naked eye as the fuzzy patch in Orion's sword.
Yıldızlar yalnız doğmaz; kardeşleriyle b: Stars are not born alone; they are born together with their siblings. The Pleiades is a young family just like this. It is about 100 million years old; compared with the Sun, it counts as a baby. It contains more than 1,000 stars, but with the naked eye usually six or seven of them are seen; that is why, in many cultures, it is known as the Seven Sisters. The haze around its bright blue stars is the reflection of a dust cloud that the cluster is passing through. Within a few hundred million years these siblings will disperse and mix into the galaxy.
Bir yıldızın yaşamının en uzun ve en sak: The longest and calmest period of a star's life is the main-sequence phase. The Sun is in exactly this phase: for 4.5 billion years it has been converting hydrogen into helium in its core, and it will continue to do so for about 5 billion years more. Every second it burns 600 million tons of hydrogen. This delicate balance between the pressure pushing outward and the gravity pulling inward keeps the star stable. When this balance breaks down, old age begins.
Betelgeuse, yaşamının sonuna yaklaşmış b: Betelgeuse shows what a star nearing the end of its life looks like. When the hydrogen in its core ran out, it swelled into a red supergiant; if it were in the Sun's place, it would extend as far as Jupiter's orbit. It is only 10 million years old, but because it is about 15 times as massive as the Sun, it used up its fuel very quickly. In 2019 it suddenly dimmed; a giant dust cloud that broke away from its surface had veiled it. Within the next 100,000 years it will explode as a supernova and be visible even in daylight.
Güneş gibi orta kütleli yıldızlar patlam: Medium-mass stars like the Sun do not explode; they gently blow their outer layers into space. The Ring Nebula is the most beautiful example of this. This colorful shell, 2,500 light-years away, is the outer layers cast off a few thousand years ago by a dying star. The tiny white dot remaining at the center is its core, at a temperature of 120,000 degrees, and it makes the gas shine with its ultraviolet light. In about 7 billion years the Sun, too, will become a planetary nebula like this.
Sirius, gökyüzünün en parlak yıldızı; bi: Sirius is the brightest star in the sky; it is only 8.6 light-years away from us. But what really interests us is its small companion Sirius B, which remains in the shadow of its brightness. This is a white dwarf: the core left behind by a dead star. It has the mass of the Sun and the size of the Earth; a teaspoon of its matter weighs a ton. It no longer produces energy, and only cools slowly over billions of years. This is the Sun's ultimate fate as well.
Ağır yıldızlar ise çok daha gürültülü öl: Massive stars, on the other hand, die much more noisily. The Crab Nebula is the remnant of a supernova recorded by Chinese and Arab astronomers in 1054. That explosion was visible even in daylight for three weeks. Today this filamentary cloud, 6 light-years across, continues to expand at 1,500 kilometers per second. At its center is the neutron star left over from the explosion: the Crab Pulsar, spinning 30 times a second. The iron, gold, and other heavy elements in the star are scattered into space by explosions like this; the calcium in your body was once inside a star.
Ve en ağır yıldızlar için son durak: kar: And for the most massive stars, the final stop: a black hole. Cygnus X-1 is the first black hole to be discovered. This object of 21 solar masses draws gas from its blue supergiant companion; the gas heats to millions of degrees in the accretion disk and emits X-rays. The two orbit their common center of mass once every 5.5 days. Not even light can escape from inside the event horizon. A journey that begins in a gas cloud ends in a hole opened in spacetime itself. The life of stars tour ends here.
Dünya yörüngesinden yıldızlararası uzaya: From Earth orbit to interstellar space: the ISS, Hubble, JWST, Parker, and the Voyagers.
İnsanlığın uzaydaki elçilerini ziyaret e: We begin from Earth orbit this tour, on which we will visit humanity's envoys in space. Before you is the International Space Station. It orbits at an altitude of 400 kilometers, at a speed of 28,000 kilometers per hour, and completes a circuit of Earth in 90 minutes; astronauts see 16 sunrises a day. It is the size of a football field and weighs 420 tons. Humans have lived aboard it without interruption since November 2000; this is humanity's longest continuous presence in space.
Hubble Uzay Teleskobu, bin dokuz yüz dok: The Hubble Space Telescope has been changing our view of the universe since 1990. It orbits at an altitude of 540 kilometers and, with its 2.4-meter mirror, captures images free of the atmosphere's blur. Its first images were blurry; a small flaw in its mirror was corrected in orbit by astronauts in 1993. It measured the age of the universe, contributed to the discovery of dark energy, and with its Deep Field images showed thousands of galaxies in a spot of sky that appeared empty.
James Webb Uzay Teleskobu, Dünya'dan bir: The James Webb Space Telescope orbits around Lagrange point 2, 1.5 million kilometers from Earth on the side opposite the Sun. Its 6.5-meter gold-coated mirror is made of 18 hexagonal segments, and it was folded up on Christmas 2021, when it was launched. Because it sees in infrared light, it is cooled to minus 233 degrees by a sunshield the size of a tennis court. It is studying the universe's first galaxies, the interiors of the dust clouds where stars are born, and the atmospheres of exoplanets.
Parker Güneş Sondası, Güneş'e dokunan il: The Parker Solar Probe is the first spacecraft to touch the Sun. It was launched in 2018 and, using Venus's gravity, tightened its orbit step by step. In December 2024 it came within 6.9 million kilometers of the Sun's surface; at that time, at 690,000 kilometers per hour, it became the fastest human-made object. Its 11-centimeter carbon shield withstands 1,400 degrees while the instruments behind it stay at room temperature. Its goal is to solve why the Sun's outer atmosphere is hundreds of times hotter than its surface.
New Horizons, iki bin altıda Dünya'dan a: New Horizons was the fastest spacecraft to leave Earth in 2006; it crossed the Moon's distance in 9 hours. After a journey of 9.5 years, it flew past Pluto in July 2015 and turned a blurry dot into a real world, with its mountains, glaciers, and heart. Then in 2019 it visited snowman-shaped Arrokoth in the Kuiper Belt; this is the most distant object a spacecraft has studied. It is still working and measuring the outer limits of the Solar System.
Voyager 1 is the most distant human-made object. It was launched in 1977; it visited Jupiter and Saturn, and gave up Pluto in order to approach Titan. In 2012, by crossing the boundary of the solar wind, it became the first spacecraft to enter interstellar space. Today it is 25 billion kilometers away; its signals take more than 22 hours to reach us. Aboard it is a golden record carrying greetings in 55 languages and the sounds of Earth: for someone who may find it one day.
Ve Voyager İki, dört dış gezegenin hepsi: And Voyager 2 is the only spacecraft to have visited all four outer planets. It was launched 16 days before its sibling, but on a slower route it flew past Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Most of what we know about Uranus and Neptune still comes from its flybys in 1986 and 1989. It reached interstellar space in 2018. The plutonium batteries of both Voyagers are weakening; they will fall silent in the 2030s, but they will continue to glide among the stars for billions of years. Our tour ends here.
En yakın yıldızlardan gökyüzünün en parl: From the nearest stars to the brightest in the sky: six stars, six stories.
Komşu yıldızlar turuna hoş geldiniz. İlk: Welcome to the Nearby Stars tour. Our first stop is the closest star to the Sun: Proxima Centauri, 4.2 light-years away. It is a small, cool red dwarf; it has only 12 percent of the Sun's mass and is too faint to be seen with the naked eye. But with sudden flares it spews violent radiation from its surface. In 2016, a planet the size of Earth was discovered around it: Proxima b orbits in the habitable zone, that is, at a distance where liquid water could be found on its surface. With our fastest vehicles today, it would take 70,000 years to get there.
Proxima aslında büyük bir ailenin uzak ü: Proxima is actually a distant member of a large family. Alpha Centauri A and B are two stars 4.4 light-years away that orbit each other once every 80 years. A is surprisingly similar to the Sun: a little larger, a little brighter. B, though, is a little smaller and orange. Together they appear as the third-brightest star in the sky. The Breakthrough Starshot project dreams of sending laser-propelled, postage-stamp-sized probes here at one-fifth the speed of light, and of arriving in 20 years.
Vega, yirmi beş ışık yılı uzaklıktaki pa: Vega is the bright blue-white star 25 light-years away. It has twice the mass of the Sun and 40 times its brightness. It spins so fast that its equator is noticeably bulging compared with its poles; what's more, we are looking at it almost exactly from its pole. Around it, a dust disk was found that may be a remnant of planet formation. Because Earth's axis slowly wobbles, Vega was the North Star 12,000 years ago and will be again in 12,000 years. For centuries, astronomers used it as the zero point of the brightness scale.
Polaris, Kutup Yıldızı. Gökyüzünün en pa: Polaris, the North Star. It is not the brightest star in the sky, but it is one of the most important: it stands less than 1 degree from the extension of Earth's rotation axis, so the whole sky appears to turn around it. For centuries it showed sailors the north. In fact it is a yellow supergiant 430 light-years away, 2,000 times brighter than the Sun, and with two small companions it forms a triple system. It is also a Cepheid variable: by brightening and dimming rhythmically once every 4 days, it teaches us to measure cosmic distances.
Antares, Akrep takımyıldızının kalbi. Ad: Antares, the heart of the constellation Scorpius. Its name means the rival of Mars in Greek, because with its red color and brightness it used to be likened to the planet. This red supergiant, 550 light-years away, has a diameter about 700 times that of the Sun; if you put it in the Sun's place, it would swallow the orbit of Mars. Its density, though, is even lower than air. Antares is 12 times as heavy as the Sun and is about to exhaust its fuel; within the next 1 million years it will explode as a supernova.
Son durağımız Deneb, Kuğu takımyıldızını: Our last stop is Deneb, the tail of the constellation Cygnus and the most distant star on this tour: about 2,600 light-years. Even so, it is one of the 20 brightest stars in the sky, because it is one of the brightest stars known, giving off about 200,000 times more light than the Sun. The light you see today set out in the era when the Roman Republic was founded. Deneb is a blue-white supergiant, and within a few million years it will either become a supernova or turn into a red supergiant. Our Nearby Stars tour has come to an end.
Samanyolu'nun dışına çıkıp uydu galaksil: Step outside the Milky Way and visit our satellite galaxies, Andromeda, and colliding galaxies.
Galaksiler turuna hoş geldiniz. Önce evi: Welcome to the galaxies tour. First, let's look at our home from the outside. The Milky Way is a spiral galaxy 100,000 light-years across, with a bar at its center, and it contains between 200 and 400 billion stars. The Sun lies 26,000 light-years from the center, in a small arm called the Orion Arm, and completes one orbit around the galaxy in 230 million years. Since the dinosaurs vanished, the Sun has completed only a quarter of this orbit. Hidden in the bright central bulge is a black hole of 4 million solar masses.
Büyük Macellan Bulutu, Samanyolu'nun en: The Large Magellanic Cloud is the Milky Way's largest satellite galaxy. It lies 160,000 light-years away, and from the southern hemisphere it looks to the naked eye like a broken-off piece of cloud in the sky. Its mass is about 1 percent of ours. Inside it are the Tarantula Nebula, the largest stellar nursery in the Local Group, and R 136 a 1, one of the most massive stars known. The supernova that exploded here in 1987 was the first supernova visible to the naked eye in 400 years. Within a few billion years, the Milky Way will swallow it.
Küçük Macellan Bulutu, iki yüz bin ışık: The Small Magellanic Cloud is its smaller sibling, 200,000 light-years away. It is an irregular galaxy; the gravity of the Large Magellanic Cloud and the Milky Way probably made it into this shapeless form. A hydrogen bridge stretching between the two is the trace of a close encounter. In 1912, Henrietta Leavitt studied thousands of variable stars here and discovered the period-luminosity relation of Cepheid stars. This discovery became the first cosmic ruler that lets us measure distances in the universe.
Andromeda, en yakın büyük komşumuz. İki: Andromeda is our nearest large neighbor. It lies 2.5 million light-years away and is the most distant object visible to the naked eye; the light you see today set out when there were not yet any humans on Earth. In 1923, Edwin Hubble measured a Cepheid star here and proved that Andromeda was not part of the Milky Way, but an entirely different galaxy; overnight, the universe grew millions of times larger. It contains 1 trillion stars and is approaching us at 110 kilometers per second. In about 4.5 billion years it will merge with the Milky Way to form a giant elliptical galaxy.
Üçgen Galaksisi, Yerel Grup'un üçüncü bü: The Triangulum Galaxy is the third-largest member of the Local Group. It lies 2.7 million light-years away, and with 40 billion stars it is the little sibling of Andromeda and the Milky Way. It has no prominent central bulge or supermassive black hole; we see its arms almost from above. Inside it lies NGC 604, a giant star-forming region 1,500 light-years across; it is 100 times larger than the Orion Nebula. It is probably a satellite of Andromeda and will one day join it.
Şimdi Yerel Grup'tan çıkıp Virgo Kümesi': Now we are leaving the Local Group and going to the heart of the Virgo Cluster, 55 million light-years away. M87 is a giant elliptical galaxy. It has no spiral arms; it is an enormous sphere of trillions of old, yellow stars, and more than 12,000 globular star clusters orbit around it; the Milky Way has only 150. At its center is the first black hole ever photographed, of 6.5 billion solar masses. The jet shooting from this black hole stretches for 5,000 light-years and has been known since 1918.
Sombrero Galaksisi adını hak ediyor: yir: The Sombrero Galaxy deserves its name: we are looking at this galaxy, 29 million light-years away, almost exactly from its edge. Its extraordinarily large and bright central bulge is surrounded by a sharp dust lane; just like a wide-brimmed Mexican hat. It hosts about 2,000 globular clusters and a black hole of 1 billion solar masses at its center. Whether it is spiral or elliptical was debated for a long time; infrared observations showed that it is a disk embedded inside an elliptical galaxy.
Son durağımızda galaksilerin de çarpışab: At our final stop we will see that galaxies can collide too. The Antennae are two spiral galaxies 45 million light-years away, passing through each other. The encounter began about 600 million years ago. Gravity flung two long tails of stars out into space; these are the insect antennae that give them their name. Stars do not collide with each other, the distances between them are very large; but the gas clouds collide and compress, giving birth to billions of new stars. Within a few hundred million years the two will turn into a single elliptical galaxy. The future of the Milky Way and Andromeda will look exactly like this too. Our galaxies tour has come to an end.
